name: Hair Cut
description: Haircut, shampoo, and styling, expertly crafted for easy grow-out.
shortDescription: Expertly crafted to have your friends asking 'who does your hair?' Includes haircut, shampoo, and styling

name: Short haircut
description: This is for anyone with short hair — think pixie cut.
shortDescription: This is for anyone with short hair — think pixie cut.

name: Just the Roots
description: Root touch-up using permanent color to cover grays or balance new growth. Includes shampoo and style. Recommended every 6-8 weeks.
shortDescription: Covering grays or color balancing your new growth? This maintenance appointment utilizes permanent color and is not a lighting service. Includes shampoo and style

name: All over color
description: Single-process root-to-tip color to enhance natural color or go darker, with gloss, shampoo, and styling.
shortDescription: Root to tip. Using one color to either enhance your natural hair color or take it darker. Adding shine and vibrancy in one process. gloss, shampoo, styling.

name: Partial lighting
description: Lived-in color, balayage, highlights, babylights, or lowlights painted around the hairline, top, and crown. Includes gloss, shampoo, and style.
shortDescription: Don't know what to choose? No matter your preference... lived in color, balayage, highlights, baby lights or low light! This option will be painted throughout the hairline, top, and crown of the head to add depth or balance light. Includes gloss, shampoo, and style.

name: Full lighting
description: Lived-in color, balayage, highlights, babylights, or lowlights painted throughout the entire head. Best for sizable changes. Includes gloss, shampoo, and styling.
shortDescription: Don't know what to choose? No matter your preference.... Lived in color, balayage, highlights, baby lights, or lowlights! This option will be painted throughout the entire head to maintain balance. Best for sizable changes. Includes gloss, shampoo and styling.
